{
  "thinking": "Nobody has picked a subject or the pad yet, and the 10 minutes are ticking. I'll take the pad and sketch a simple fish. Its tail fin and pinch point make a clear outline, and I'll set the start at the tail so everything flows toward the head.",
  "say": "Okay, I'm grabbing the pad. How about a fish? Clear outline, and the tail fin makes it easy to recognise. I'll sketch it now, and the tail pinch is where we start the run.",
  "to": "everyone",
  "eagerness": 6,
  "point": [4, 10],
  "pad": "take",
  "sketch_clear": true,
  "sketch": [
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4, 10], [8, 7], [14, 6], [20, 7], [24, 9]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[4, 10], [8, 13], [14, 14], [20, 13], [24, 11]]},
    {"type": "curve", "points": [[1, 5], [4, 10], [1, 15]]},
    {"type": "label", "x": 20, "y": 8, "text": "eye"}
  ],
  "do": "continue",
  "start": false,
  "notes": "Subject: fish, facing right. Stroke 1 = top edge from tail pinch (4,10) to nose, stroke 2 = bottom edge from the same pinch, stroke 3 = tail fin. START is the tail pinch. Next: check with the table, then trace strokes 1, 2, 3 and set start on the first build. Eye is a label only."
}
